title: The Last Library
logline: An aging scientist begs a pilot to extract the last surviving records from an orbital archive before the local star expands and consumes it, but a rigid dockmaster refuses to let them launch.

roles.description: Spent their entire life curating the archive, refusing to leave without it.
Cares more about evacuation protocols than cultural history.
A massive, beautiful station slowly melting in the heat.
A heavily shielded transport designed to carry delicate data cores.

public_situation: The local star has entered its final expansion phase, bathing the {role:orbital_archive} in lethal radiation and heat.
private_truth: The dockmaster has locked the archive shuttle down because they are secretly using it to smuggle their own stolen goods off-station.

beats.public_change: The outer hull of the archive begins to glow red-hot.

missions.reason: The scientist asks the pilot to scan the archive to confirm the data cores haven't melted yet.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the cooling systems have already failed.

beats.public_change: The dockmaster orders all ships to evacuate immediately, officially abandoning the archive.

missions.reason: The scientist begs the pilot to physically extract the massive data cores from the melting station.
missions.private_fact: The pilot's ship will suffer intense heat damage during the extraction.

beats.public_change: The star releases a massive solar flare, threatening to consume everything.

missions.reason: The dockmaster attempts to flee in the archive shuttle with their smuggled goods. The scientist pays the pilot to destroy the shuttle to punish the dockmaster.
missions.private_fact: The dockmaster hails the pilot, offering half their smuggled fortune if the pilot lets them escape and leaves the scientist to die.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the shuttle and escapes with the data cores.
resolutions.summary: The dockmaster perishes, but the scientist's life work is saved. The data cores become the foundation of a new planetary university.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot risked melting their hull to pull centuries of history out of a dying star.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the dockmaster's offer.
resolutions.summary: The pilot and the dockmaster escape with the smuggled wealth. The scientist and the archive are consumed by the expanding star.
The dockmaster forces the evacuation, dragging the scientist away. The archive and all its history burns.

loose_threads.detail: The 'smuggled goods' the dockmaster was protecting were actually rare cultural artifacts stolen from the archive itself.
The star's expansion isn't natural; scan data shows signs of an illegal stellar-mining operation gone terribly wrong.

radio_hooks: Final evacuation orders issued for sectors near the expanding star.
{role:aging_scientist} broadcasts tearful farewell to centuries of history.

voice_direction.aging_scientist: Slow, full of regret, speaks about data like it's a living child.
voice_direction.rigid_dockmaster: Loud, angry, insists everything is fine while panicking.
